name: summarizer
description: Create concise study summaries from course materials.

interface.longDescription: Turn course materials and relevant conversation context into structured, exam-friendly knowledge outlines. Organize concepts by dependency, preserve course terminology and notation, compare easily confused concepts, support multilingual technical terms, and generate concise Markdown study notes with quick-reference sections when useful.
defaultPrompt: Summarize these chapters into an exam-ready knowledge outline.
Turn these lecture notes into structured review notes.
Summarize this course material while preserving important exam terminology.
